Don-Jo 70-630, Satin Stainless Steel 3-1/2 x 15 Push Plate

This 3-1/2 inch x 15 inch push plates for swinging doors is primarily used in restaurants, warehouses, factories, and stores. The 3-1/2 x 15 Satin Stainless Push Plate is made of .050 inch thick stainless steel. It has a satin stainless steel finish. The Commercial Bathroom Door Push Plate comes packaged with mounting hardware for easy installation.

Also Available: 3-1/2 x 15 Satin Stainless Pull Plate

Specifications of the Don-Jo 70-360 3.5 x 15 Inch Satin Stainless Push Plate:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Plate Height: 15"
  • Plate Width: 3-1/2"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Packaged With Mounting Screws
